WITH overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(instownpct) as overall_avg
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  WHERE instownpct IS NOT NULL
),
timing_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(eventannotm, 'Missing') as timing,
    AVG(instownpct) as timing_avg
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  WHERE instownpct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY eventannotm
)
SELECT 
  AVG(timing_avg) as mean_of_above_avg_timings,
  AVG(timing_avg - overall_avg) as avg_distance_above
FROM timing_avgs
CROSS JOIN overall_avg
WHERE timing_avg > overall_avg
